jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Atlassian is hiring a Senior Data Platform Engineer in Sydney to design and own big data and software solutions. The role requires 5+ years of experience with Kotlin/Scala/Java/Python and cloud platforms including AWS or GCP, and hands-on use of Spark, Flink, Databricks, and Airflow.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Data Business Partner
jobs.description: This is not a typical Senior Data Engineer role at REA Group. Engineering skills are used as a tool for enablement and scale. The role coaches Data Product Owners and teams in data-as-a-product thinking, and tracks the value delivered through data domain partnership by measuring adoption, maturity progression, data health improvements, and business outcomes.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Machine Learning
jobs.description: REA Group's team builds data and AI products using audience segmentation, large language models, and multimodal vision-language models. Responsibilities include deploying and monitoring ML pipelines in Python with PyTorch and AWS, and building real-time and batch data pipelines with Airflow, BigQuery, and Kafka.

jobs.title: Hyper-Edge Technology Development Engineer Graduate (Data Application) 2027
jobs.description: TikTok Australia is hiring 2027 graduate Data Application engineers. By harnessing the vast log data generated by CDNs, the team develops intelligent tools to optimise performance, minimise costs, and enhance user experiences, implementing Hyper-Edge technologies and designing large-scale global scheduling systems. Requires proficiency in at least one of C, C++, Go, Java, or Python, with an onboarding date by end of 2027.

jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist, GenAI & LLMs
jobs.description: Suncorp is hiring a Principal Data Scientist in a hands-on role spanning data science, generative AI, and AI engineering, focused on building production systems. The role requires 8+ years across Data Science, Machine Learning, AI, and Software Engineering, with skills in RAG, embeddings, vector search, LLM evaluation, and agentic workflows. Salary range A$185K–A$235K, based in Sydney, Melbourne, or Brisbane. Posted October 2026.

jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist, Analytics Fin Crime & Fraud
jobs.description: National Australia Bank is hiring a Principal Data Scientist on the Analytics, Fin Crime and Fraud team, applying advanced machine learning and data science to financial crime detection and fraud prevention. The role is based in Victoria and is valid through 27 October 2026.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: NAB's Senior AI Engineer role in Melbourne is part of the AI Platforms team, building and deploying AI solutions at enterprise scale across the bank. The role requires Python, GenAI experience, and the ability to architect AI systems that serve millions of customers.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Economic Policy & AI Leadership
jobs.description: The Reserve Bank of Australia is seeking a Senior Data Scientist for Economic Policy and AI Leadership in Sydney, applying advanced analytics and machine learning to economic research and policy analysis. The role sits at the intersection of macroeconomics and AI-driven insights.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Personalisation
jobs.description: Canva is hiring a Data Scientist for its Personalisation team in Sydney. The role requires Python or R and SQL to build and improve personalisation systems across Canva's platform, with Snowflake listed as a strong plus.

jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist, Growth
jobs.description: Canva is hiring a Staff Data Scientist for its Growth team, a full-time remote-eligible role based in Sydney. Posted July 2026, the position focuses on driving growth metrics and experiments using advanced analytics and causal inference.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, DDAI
jobs.description: Westpac is hiring a Senior Data Scientist for its DDAI (Data, Digital and AI) team in a hybrid role across Sydney, Melbourne, or Brisbane. The role involves designing, building, and deploying production-grade generative AI and machine learning solutions. Posted August 29, 2026.

jobs.title: Senior Data and AI Engineer
jobs.description: Cartology, Woolworths Group's retail media arm, is hiring a Senior Data and AI Engineer in Surry Hills, Sydney (hybrid). The role covers production data pipelines, models, and audience datasets for segmentation and campaign measurement using BigQuery, dbt, Airflow, and Python on GCP. Requires 5+ years of experience.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, AI & Analytics

jobs.title: AI Specialist Solution Architect, ANZ
jobs.description: Red Hat is hiring an AI Specialist Solution Architect based in Sydney or Melbourne. The role involves designing and proposing enterprise AI solutions to clients across Australia and New Zealand, covering Red Hat's AI and ML portfolio including OpenShift AI.

jobs.title: AI Engineer, Build the Future of Banking
jobs.description: NAB is hiring an AI Engineer in Melbourne to help design, develop, and deploy AI solutions at enterprise scale, building the future of banking. The role involves working on the AI Platforms team to deliver machine learning and generative AI capabilities. Posted August 2026.

jobs.title: AI Reporting & Data Analytics Lead
jobs.description: Suncorp Group is hiring an AI Reporting and Data Analytics Lead in Sydney or Brisbane. The role combines data analytics capabilities with AI reporting strategy, using machine learning and advanced analytics to generate insights across the group's insurance and banking business.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer & Data Scientist, Agentic AI & LLM
jobs.description: Future Secure AI is hiring a Senior AI Engineer and Data Scientist specialising in Agentic AI and large language models in Sydney or Melbourne. The role involves building AI-powered agent systems and production LLM applications. Salary range A$180K–A$250K.

jobs.title: Principal Data & AI Engineer, Audience & Media

jobs.title: Lead Data Scientist, wiqRetail

jobs.title: Principal GenAI & AI Engineering Leader

This senior technical leadership role drives enterprise GenAI strategy, AI engineering architecture, and leads the adoption of agentic systems and large language models at scale across Suncorp's insurance and banking operations.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, ML & GenAI

jobs.title: Data Scientist, GenAI & Production ML

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Product Features & Growth
